critical_code_review_comments: sessionStorage key `ff8b_${name}` uses the raw restaurant name — safe here but note names with unusual characters could collide across storage keys; consider a hash or slug if names ever contain control chars. Not blocking.
The old comment on line 41-43 still references 'refs (attempts, lastFail)' but the code now uses sessionStorage — minor doc drift, cosmetic only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: sessionStorage key format: ff8b_<name> with value {n:int,last:int}. Cleared automatically when the answer surfaces. data-state on [data-testid=magic-8ball-overlay] reliably reflects lifecycle: idle → shaking (1.1s) → message (2s) → idle, or shaking → answer (persists ~2.6s until onDone). magic-8ball-answer / magic-8ball-fail are now conditionally rendered (only under dieUp), so selector presence is a valid state signal — no more falling back to hint text. Rattle recipe: 8 pointermove events on magic-8ball-overlay at ±150px from center with 85ms spacing. Math.random must be stubbed via page.add_init_script BEFORE goto. Use http://localhost:3000 (external preview hit a wake gate not tested here but localhost works fine).
rca of the issue: N/A — bug fixed. The iteration_38 remount-wipes-refs bug was resolved by moving attempt counters from useRef to sessionStorage (key ff8b_<name>). Verified counters persist both across normal fail→idle→shake cycles AND across explicit component remount via Replay button. MAX_FAILS=2 guarantee now holds; anti-repeat taunt rotation now works (shake1 taunt idx 0, shake2 bumped to idx 1).
